title.narrative: Climate-smart education and green schools in Chitwan, Nepal

description.narrative: Nepal is one of the most vulnerable countries to climate change, with the Global Risk Index ranking the country as the fourth most vulnerable globally. It is therefore imperative to educate Nepalis from a young age about the impacts of climate change and the various adaptation and mitigation measures associated with it. This project will focus on providing workshops to teachers on better communicating climate change in classrooms as well as in making schools greener. It will also engage with youth clubs and traditional indigenous practitioners in the region to better understand sustainable practices through inter-generation dialogues. Additionally, the schools will serve as a learning hub for environmental and climate action for the surrounding community.
